name: Casual spider-gothic
brief: A wearable casual spider-gothic outfit: relaxed matte black off-shoulder knit top layered over an opaque fitted black camisole, long sleeves with clearly readable fine spiderweb open-knit panels restricted to forearms and cuffs, a fine web-lace edge across the neckline. Black pleated skirt with restrained charcoal spiderweb embroidery across two outer pleats and web-shaped lace along its hem. Opaque dark tights with subtle small web motifs near the ankles, simple low black ankle boots with a small flat silver spider buckle. Existing black choker with tiny flat spider-glyph pendant. Keep clothing practical and covered; emphasize recognizable radial-web construction in trim, not ordinary generic floral lace. No uniform polo, blazer or academy crest for this casual outfit.
